dedupe_keys.name: n dimensional extension of unfold pca for granular systems monitoring

description: Burgas, Llorenç and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The implemented method represents repeated physical structures and periodic observations in N-dimensional arrays, then folds and unfolds them into matrices for multivariate monitoring. PCA is the demonstrated statistical model; the representation can support other monitoring methods. Two energy-efficiency examples illustrate the method, including two years of real observations from a social-housing building in central Barcelona. The record concerns this model formulation and its documented application. It does not assert that all underlying household measurements are publicly released, that a code package is provided, or that every possible monitoring algorithm was evaluated. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-sa-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; a paper licence does not establish a software licence. Coverage is limited to the stated sites, model settings and application examples. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
